# Placetta

> Placetta gets the business licenses, permits and registrations a company needs to open in a new market (restaurants, cafes, milk tea shops, retail stores, importers and warehouses), fills the official government forms and keeps them current. It covers 55 cities across the US, China, Europe and the Middle East, in English and Chinese.

Every guide lists the filings in the order they are made, with the agency, how each is filed, the government fee and a link to the agency's own page. Facts come from Placetta's library of official forms; agencies change requirements, so check the agency's page before filing.

## Start here
- [License guides, city by city](https://placetta.com/guides/): every city, business and official form
- [Get a plan for your exact address](https://placetta.com/app/): Placetta maps every filing for an address, fills the official forms and asks for approval before anything is filed
- [Full text of the answers and city guides](https://placetta.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Structured data for all guides](https://placetta.com/guides/data.json)
